{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/trial.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter for the TREATMENT arm
treatment_data = data[data['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Check the number of patients in the treatment arm
treatment_count = len(treatment_data)

# Count how many responded in the treatment arm
responded_count = treatment_data['responded'].sum()

# Calculate the fraction
fraction_responded = responded_count / treatment_count

fraction_responded"}
